calls.title: 30 min with Scott (Raymond Camden)
calls.summary: The discussion showcased a recent technical project involving an Astro-based dashboard for Webflow site activity, highlighting the use of OAuth for secure data access. Raymond expressed a preference for minimal frameworks, favoring vanilla JavaScript and Alpine.js over React, while AI tools like Claude enhanced development workflows. Effective documentation practices were emphasized, such as the clear and straightforward structure of Astro docs. The team is migrating from Docusaurus to Mintlify for improved AI-friendly documentation, aiming to reduce onboarding complexity for non-engineers. The new role will focus on creating advanced educational content to enhance the user experience and provide real developer solutions without overt marketing.
calls.keywords: Growth Book, AI Tools, Developer Relations, Astro Framework, Documentation, Feature Flagging
calls.action_items:
